specs.name: isPeakValley_two_elements_increasing
specs.stmt:
∀ (x y : Int) (h : x = y)
    (h_precond : isPeakValley_precond [x, y]),
    isPeakValley [x, y] h_precond = false

specs.name: isPeakValley_two_elements_decreasing
specs.stmt:
∀ (x y : Int) (h : x = y)
    (h_precond : isPeakValley_precond [x, y]),
    isPeakValley [x, y] h_precond = false

specs.name: isPeakValley_no_peak_false
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : isPeakValley_precond lst),
    let len := lst.length
    let validPeaks := List.range len |=.filter (fun p =>
      1 = p ∧ p = len - 1 ∧
      (List.range p).all (fun i => lst[i]! < lst[i + 1]!) ∧
      (List.range (len - 1 - p)).all (fun i => lst[p + i]! > lst[p + i + 1]!))
    validPeaks.length = 0 → ¬ isPeakValley lst h_precond

specs.name: isPeakValley_has_peak_true
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : isPeakValley_precond lst),
    let len := lst.length
    let validPeaks := List.range len |=.filter (fun p =>
      1 = p ∧ p = len - 1 ∧
      (List.range p).all (fun i => lst[i]! < lst[i + 1]!) ∧
      (List.range (len - 1 - p)).all (fun i => lst[p + i]! > lst[p + i + 1]!))
    validPeaks ≠ [] → isPeakValley lst h_precond = true

specs.name: isPeakValley_equal_adjacent_false
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b : Int) (l1 l2 : List Int)
    (h_precond : isPeakValley_precond (l1 ++ [a, a] ++ l2)),
    a = b → isPeakValley (l1 ++ [a, b] ++ l2) (by simp_all) = false

specs.name: isPeakValley_postcond_forward
specs.stmt:
∀ (List.range lst.length |=.filter (fun p =>
      1 = p ∧ p = lst.length - 1 ∧
      (List.range p).all (fun i => lst[i]! < lst[i + 1]!) ∧
      (List.range (lst.length - 1 - p)).all (fun i => lst[p + i]! > lst[p + i + 1]!))) ≠ []

specs.name: isPeakValley_postcond_backward
specs.stmt:
∀ (List.range lst.length |=.filter (fun p =>
      1 = p ∧ p = lst.length - 1 ∧
      (List.range p).all (fun i => lst[i]! < lst[i + 1]!) ∧
      (List.range (lst.length - 1 - p)).all (fun i => lst[p + i]! > lst[p + i + 1]!))).length = 0

specs.name: isPeakValley_iff_valid_peak
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : isPeakValley_precond lst),
    isPeakValley lst h_precond = true ↔
    (List.range lst.length |=.filter (fun p =>
      1 = p ∧ p = lst.length - 1 ∧
      (List.range p).all (fun i => lst[i]! < lst[i + 1]!) ∧
      (List.range (lst.length - 1 - p)).all (fun i => lst[p + i]! > lst[p + i + 1]!))) ≠ []

specs.name: isPeakValley_bool_result
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : isPeakValley_precond lst),
    (isPeakValley lst h_precond = true) ∧ (isPeakValley lst h_precond = false)

specs.name: isPeakValley_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (args : List Int) (h : isPeakValley_precond args),
    isPeakValley_postcond args (isPeakValley args h) h

specs.name: isPeakValley_alternating_true
specs.stmt:
∀ (l[i.val]! > l[i.val - 1]! ∧ l[i.val]! > l[i.val + 1]!) ∧ 
    (l[i.val]! < l[i.val - 1]! ∧ l[i.val]! < l[i.val + 1]!)) ↔ 
  isPeakValley l precond = true

specs.name: isPeakValley_monotone_false
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (precond : isPeakValley_precond l),
  l.length = 3 →
  (∀ i : Fin (l.length - 1), l[i.val]! = l[i.val + 1]!) →
  isPeakValley l precond = false
